item.title: Estimate of jet fuel spill into James River lower
item.description: A fuel spill was identified during a JP5 fuel load transfer from a Navy barge to the John F. Kennedy (CVN 79) in the James River on Friday, and cleanup and remediation efforts were initiated immediately to contain the fuel and protect the surrounding environment.

item.title: Docs: Man charged in Norfolk murder has fled to Hong Kong
item.description: The man charged with killing his wife in Norfolk has fled the United States and was last known to be in Hong Kong, according to a federal affidavit.

item.title: Hampton Roads' leaders form coalition to lure European flights after initial delay
